title: 第十九章 香水第二十章 音攻法门
content_zh:
王昱是一个正常的年轻男性。
正常年轻男性的需求他都有。
短时间内，李云岫是别想了，芊芊显然也是个会拉扯的。
王昱不是个勉强别人的性格，他毕竟不是真的赵昱，而且他也不想随意对府内的丫鬟下手。
但青楼是个好地方啊！
买一个身段、容貌、才艺俱佳的清倌人回家，既能解决自身需求，还能给芊芊些压力，这也是两全其美！
王昱打了个响指，深深地吸了一口气，然后呵斥赵英杰道，“去什么青楼，咱们出来是去给芊芊买香水！”
赵英杰：？？？
我什么时候说去青楼了？
然后他就看到了王昱的眼神，恍然大悟，连连点头，“正是正是！都是属下的错！”
芊芊在旁边掩口轻笑，娇俏的飞了王昱一眼，然后伸手挽住了王昱的胳膊，充满弹性的柔软轻轻挤压着王昱的胳膊。
“昱哥哥，你闻到香味了吗？就在前面那处帐篷！”
市场里除了固定的商铺，还有专门的广场区分成一块块空间，用来给各地游商驻扎，竖起帐篷交易，以及存储货物。
前方一座帐篷门口围了不少人，大部分衣着华丽，可见身份不凡。
王昱带着人往里走，四个侍卫立刻两前两后，分开人流，将王昱、芊芊和赵英杰护在中间，周围人群中有人认识赵英杰，看到他点头哈腰的站在一个年轻人身边，眼神不由一跳，立刻让开道路。
一进大帐，满室生香。
虽然是异域商队，千里而来，但帐篷中却是干净整洁，墙上挂着精美的波斯地毯，一条长案将入口隔开，后面放着博古架，上面摆着宝石、弯刀、首饰等等，还有一些金属小瓶。
几个高鼻深目，棕色卷发的西域人举着拧开瓶盖的金属小瓶，其中散发出浓郁的芬芳香气，正在用不太熟练的汉语介绍着手中的香水。
“这是西方万里之外最新的发明！”
“可以随身携带，只要往身上洒几滴，就可以保持香气足足一个时辰！”

“怎么制作的？这当然是秘密，而且我也不知道，我只是个商人，不是发明家。”
“我们只带了两种香水，一种薰衣草，一种郁金香。”
“十两银子一瓶。”
“嘶——”王昱倒吸了一口凉气，“好特么贵啊！果然香水从古到今都是奢侈品。”
十两银子，足够普通人一家三口生活几个月了。
但别看香水要卖十两银子一瓶，其实已经算是这家商队最便宜的物件。
其余手指大小的猫眼儿宝石，镶嵌着蓝色宝石的华丽首饰，还有金光灿灿布满碧玉红宝石刀鞘的弯刀，一个比一个贵！
旁边有人斜了王昱一眼，然后就看到了芊芊，不由嘿嘿一笑，“不贵了，一次只用两三滴，就能持续一个时辰，足够干那事儿的时候助兴了。”
“香味浓郁，比香炉更带劲。”另一人评价道，“你们带了多少？我全买了！”
为首商人露出笑容，“尊敬的客人，我们这次万里跋涉，出发时带了两百瓶，但来到这里时已经只剩下一百二十多瓶了。”
“咳咳咳！这么多呀，我先要十瓶吧。”
“一瓶十二两，我们全要了！”一个声音突然从帐篷入口处传来。
content_en:
Wang Yu is a normal young man.
He has all the needs of a normal young man.
In a short period of time, Li Yunxiu would no longer think about it, and Qianqian was obviously someone who was good at teasing.
Wang Yu is not a person who forces others to do anything. After all, he is not really Zhao Yu, and he does not want to attack the maids in the house at will.
But the brothel is a good place!
Buying a gentry with good figure, appearance, and talents to take home can not only solve your own needs, but also put some pressure on Qianqian. This is the best of both worlds!
Wang Yu snapped his fingers, took a deep breath, and then scolded Zhao Yingjie, "What kind of brothel are you going to? We came out to buy perfume for Qianqian!"
Zhao Yingjie:? ? ?
When did I say I was going to a brothel?
Then he saw Wang Yu's eyes, suddenly realized, and nodded repeatedly, "Exactly! It's all my subordinates' fault!"
Qianqian covered her mouth and chuckled beside her, gave Wang Yu a cute look, then reached out to hold Wang Yu's arm, and gently squeezed Wang Yu's arm with her elastic softness.
"Brother Yu, do you smell the fragrance? It's in the tent in front!"
In addition to the fixed shops in the market, there are also special square areas divided into spaces, which are used for traveling merchants from all over the place to station, erect tents for trading, and store goods.
There were many people gathered at the door of a tent ahead, most of them dressed in gorgeous clothes, which showed that they had extraordinary status.
Wang Yu led the people inside, and the four guards immediately separated the flow of people, keeping Wang Yu, Qianqian and Zhao Yingjie in the middle. Some people in the crowd knew Zhao Yingjie, and when they saw him standing beside a young man with a nod and hunched posture, his eyes jumped and he immediately got out of the way.
As soon as you enter the big tent, the room is filled with fragrance.
Although it was a foreign caravan that had come thousands of miles away, the tent was clean and tidy, with exquisite Persian carpets hanging on the walls. A long table separated the entrance. Behind it was a book shelf with gems, scimitars, jewelry, etc., as well as some metal vials.
Several Westerners with tall noses, deep eyes, and brown curly hair held small metal bottles with unscrewed caps, which exuded a rich fragrant aroma, and were introducing the perfumes in their hands in unskilled Chinese.
"This is the latest invention thousands of miles away in the West!"
"You can carry it with you. Just sprinkle a few drops on your body and the scent will last for an hour!"
"How to make it? Of course it's a secret, and I don't know. I'm just a businessman, not an inventor."
"We only brought two perfumes, one lavender and one tulip."
"Ten taels of silver a bottle."
"Hiss—" Wang Yu took a breath, "It's so expensive! Sure enough, perfume has been a luxury product since ancient times."
Ten taels of silver is enough for an ordinary family of three to live for several months.
But despite the fact that a bottle of perfume costs ten taels of silver, it is actually the cheapest item in this caravan.
The other finger-sized cat's-eye gemstones, gorgeous jewelry inlaid with blue gemstones, and a scimitar with a scabbard of jasper and ruby ​​shining with golden light, each one is more expensive than the last!
Someone next to him glanced sideways at Wang Yu, then saw Qianqian, and couldn't help but chuckle, "It's not expensive. You only need two or three drops at a time, and it lasts for an hour. It's enough to cheer you up when you're doing that."
"The fragrance is rich and more powerful than an incense burner." Another person commented, "How many did you bring? I bought them all!"
The leading businessman smiled and said, "Dear guest, we took two hundred bottles with us when we set off on this journey of thousands of miles, but when we got here, we only had more than one hundred and twenty bottles left."
"Ahem! There are so many. I want ten bottles first."
"Twelve taels in a bottle, we want them all!" A voice suddenly came from the entrance of the tent.
